notes:
DELTA BATCH FOR TWO CONVERGENCE FIXES, not a re-adjudication. aurora_lint 1445 (b0cac5ab, null-state propagation run to convergence instead of stopping at 3 passes) and 1451 (b70755d5, call sites collected inside a top-level ERROR node) each widened the caller-state seed that EXP34-C consults, and each commit states that its new keys need delta-adjudication before any EXP34-C precision or recall claim. No batch had covered them (bmdb 1492 checked the full history). 1443 (575393b5) removed 91 already-FP keys and added none, so it owes nothing.

HOW THE SET WAS MEASURED. No official run contains these fixes (the newest realworld run is 270, 2960cd88). So the batch source is a local scan at aurora-lint a533858c over the 12 pinned corpora (corpus-check clean), each corpus driven by bench/realworld_runner._build_sqc_cmd with its real manifest filtered to EXP34-C, INT32-C, MEM31-C and EXP33-C, in-scope via bench.corpus.in_scope, keys (file, line, rule). Taken: keys with no label at the pinned commit on main that run 270 did not report. EXP34-C gave 270 such keys; the 195 in valkey are excluded because valkey has no EXP34-C oracle at all (bmdb 1249's gap, filed separately by the coordinator). That leaves 75 EXP34-C keys plus 2 EXP33-C. The 14 MEM31-C keys in the same window are aurora_lint 1487's loop-array relocations, which bmdb 1491 adjudicated separately, so they are not here. Per corpus the EXP34-C counts sit close to the two commits' own stated deltas (hostap 35 = 4 + 31) but are not attributed to them key by key: other EXP34-C commits since run 270 also move keys.

STANDARD. Same as the 1418 batch: the violation site is the dereference, and the verdict rests on whether a null-producing expression reaches it on some path in the pinned tree. Caller sets were enumerated at source; confidence is high where the set was closed. Assertions, API contracts and build-macro guards (ADR-0010 Decision 1) are neutral, never a basis.

RESULT: 76 FP, 1 uncertain, 0 TP. The dominant shape (most hostap and mosquitto keys) is a parameter whose every caller has already dereferenced or tested the same pointer. The next is an out-parameter set non-null on every success return and read only after that status (mbedtls PSA slots and ssl_cache, curl digest, mosquitto message__remove, hostap assoc_hapd and rkh_seq). None is a misfire: each message names the construct at its line and column.

THE UNCERTAIN ROW. sqlite src/status.c:216 (public sqlite3_db_status64): its only guard is under #ifdef SQLITE_ENABLE_API_ARMOR and is not used. The in-scope call sites pass an open connection. The one in-tree caller whose handle can be 0 is the JNI binding under ext/jni, which is out of scope. The dataset has not decided whether an out-of-scope caller counts as a null producer for an in-scope dereference, so the row is uncertain rather than decided here.

NO PRECISION OR RECALL CLAIM follows from this batch. The keys were measured on a local scan at a533858c; the release run's own unlabeled list is authoritative once it exists.

Adjudicated on dev-149 under bmdb 1492: five read-only research agents, one per project group, each verdict spot-checked at source by dev-149 before inclusion.
